topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Oh wow, I just got these amazing flowers this morning and there’s no card or anything! I mean, look at them, they’re so vibrant and just... wow. I’ve been trying to guess who might have sent them all day. Maybe it’s from someone who knows I love sunflowers? Or could it be someone trying to cheer me up? I keep thinking it’s got to be someone special, you know? I’m just so curious, and my mind is racing with all these ideas. What if it’s from an old friend or someone I’ve lost touch with? I can’t stop thinking about it.
